Subject: Contract renewal

Dear Ms. Ito,

Our current agreement expires on 30 June. Although the prices have increased, we are pleased to offer you the same rate for another year because you have been a loyal client since 2019. Please sign and return the enclosed contract by 15 June. Unless we receive it by that date, the rate will change. Thank you for your continued business.

Sincerely,

Peter Wallace
